standard_prerequisites.name: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism the pushforward on quasi-coherent complexes has finite cohomological dimension N, so R^0f_* agrees with R^0f_* of the truncation tau_{>= -N}
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets every family be truncated to a uniformly bounded below one.

standard_prerequisites.name: The cohomology of the pushforward of a complex is computed from the pushforwards of its cohomology sheaves by the two spectral sequences of a complex functor
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the general direct sum statement to the case where the objects are sheaves in a single degree.

standard_prerequisites.name: For quasi-coherent sheaves the cohomology of a direct sum is the direct sum of the cohomologies on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: Handles the single-degree case and finishes the proof.

core_obligations: Let E_i be a family in D_QCoh(O_X) with direct sum E; the goal is that (direct sum of Rf_*E_i) to Rf_*E is an isomorphism, and it suffices to prove it induces an isomorphism on degree zero cohomology sheaves; this may be checked locally on S, so assume S quasi-compact (proof lines 810-817).

Choose N as in Lemma quasi-coherence-direct-image; then R^0f_*E = R^0f_* tau_{>= -N} E and likewise for the E_i, while tau_{>= -N} E = direct sum of tau_{>= -N} E_i; so reduce to families with cohomology sheaves vanishing below -N (proof lines 817-823).

Use the two spectral sequences R^pf_*H^q(E) => R^{p+q}f_*E and its per-object variant (Derived Categories, Lemma two-ss-complex-functor) to reduce to the case of a direct sum of quasi-coherent sheaves; this case is handled by Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma colimit-cohomology, completing the proof (proof lines 824-835).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to degree zero cohomology sheaves and quasi-compact S (proof lines 810-817).
Truncate the family uniformly using the finite cohomological dimension (proof lines 817-823).
Reduce via the spectral sequences to sheaves and conclude by the colimit cohomology lemma (proof lines 824-835).
